data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 's-b-h', meaning 'to help, support, or assist'. Sabuhi is a name given to a companion or helper, one who is always there to lend a hand. In Islamic tradition, Sabuhi is considered a name of wisdom, intelligence, and power. The name Sabuhi carries the meaning “Companion, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Sabuhi usually hope their child will grow to embody companion, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
